This endpoint returns organic statistics only. Sponsored activity is not counted in this endpoint. Use Ad Analytics to retrieve statistics for sponsored activity.

Lifetime share statistics: To retrieve lifetime share statistics, omit the timeIntervals query parameter. The API returns aggregated statistics for an organization's shares.

Time-bound share statistics: To retrieve time-bound share statistics, include the timeIntervals query parameter. The API returns aggregate share statistics within all of the days or months in between the selected date range based on the specified timeIntervals.timeGranularityType.
The organizationalEntityShareStatistics endpoint returns share data only within the past 12 months, using a rolling 12-month window.

Rows.Text: Manage organizations pages and retrieve reporting data. Restricted to organizations in which the authenticated member has the following role: ADMINISTRATOR
The organizational entity URN for which the statistics represents.
The share URN for describing individual share statistics. Is blank for aggregate share statistics.
The UGC Post URN for describing individual share statistics.
Inclusive starting timestamp of when the query should begin. The smallest supported time granularity is on DAY level. For example, Nov 04 2025 23:59:59 is normalized to Nov 04 2025.
Share statistics representing the total counts.
Number of organic clicks, likes, comments, and shares over impressions.
Number of likes. This field can become negative when members who liked a sponsored share later unlike it. The like is not counted since it's not organic, but the unlike is counted as organic.

Rows.Text: URN Must be of the format urn:li:organization:{id} or urn:li:organizationBrand:{id}
Time restriction for the query. When omitted, lifetime stats are returned as shown in response below.
Granularity of the statistics. Must be either DAY or MONTH.

Inclusive starting timestamp of when the query should begin (milliseconds since epoch) Queries from beginning of time when not set. The smallest supported time granularity is on DAY level. For example, Nov 04 2025 23:59:59 is normalized to Nov 04 2025.

Exclusive ending timestamp of when the query should end (milliseconds since epoch). Queries until current time when not set. The smallest supported time granularity is on DAY level. For example, Nov 04 2025 23:59:59 is normalized to Nov 04 2025.
References to one or more shares for which statistics are returned.
References to one or more UGC Posts for which statistics are returned.

Specify the timeIntervals parameter to retrieve time-bound share statistics.
Fetch daily organization share statistics for the first week of March 2019.
Restli 1.0:

http


curl

GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/organizationalEntityShareStatistics?q=organizationalEntity&organizationalEntity=urn:li:organization:2414183&timeIntervals.timeGranularityType=DAY&timeIntervals.timeRange.start=1551398400000&timeIntervals.timeRange.end=1552003200000

curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/organizationalEntityShareStatistics?q=organizationalEntity&organizationalEntity=urn:li:organization:2414183&timeIntervals.timeGranularityType=DAY&timeIntervals.timeRange.start=1551398400000&timeIntervals.timeRange.end=1552003200000' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json'

curl

GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/organizationalEntityShareStatistics?q=organizationalEntity&organizationalEntity=urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A2414183&timeIntervals=(timeRange:(start:1551398400000,end:1552003200000),timeGranularityType:DAY)'

curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/organizationalEntityShareStatistics?q=organizationalEntity&organizationalEntity=urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A2414183&timeIntervals=(timeRange:(start:1551398400000,end:1552003200000),timeGranularityType:DAY)' \

curl --location 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/organizationalEntityShareStatistics?q=organizationalEntity&organizationalEntity=urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A79988552&timeIntervals=(timeRange%3A(start%3A1551398400000%2Cend%3A1552003200000)%2CtimeGranularityType%3ADAY)' \

Note
The shareCount for the time-bound statistics won't match the lifetime statistics because the time-bound data won't include the count from instant reposts.
Note

A share URN is required for this API. Either post a new organization share or retrieve an existing organization share to get one.
Time-bound statistics is not supported for specific share queries.
Fetch lifetime share statistics for two specific organization shares.

http


curl

GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/organizationalEntityShareStatistics?q=organizationalEntity&organizationalEntity=urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A2414183&shares=List(urn%3Ali%3Ashare%3A7132564752928563200,urn%3Ali%3Ashare%3A7132402731377438720)

curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/organizationalEntityShareStatistics?q=organizationalEntity&organizationalEntity=urn%3Ali%3Aorganization%3A2414183&shares=List(urn%3Ali%3Ashare%3A7132564752928563200%2Curn%3Ali%3Ashare%3A7132402731377438720)' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json'
Elements with share fields indicate each requested share.
Shares with no actions or impressions are not included in the list of elements. Shares that are not returned in the list of elements can be assumed to have counts of 0 for all statistics.
